articles.title: From Chai Pani to Cal-India Collective: Indian Cuisine Earns Its Biggest-Ever Haul at the 2026 James Beard Awards
articles.excerpt: With multiple Indian-origin chefs and restaurateurs nominated across national categories, this year's ceremony on June 15 could mark a turning point for South Asian food in America.
articles.image_caption: The exterior of Chai Pani restaurant in Asheville, North Carolina, a 2026 James Beard finalist
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dal Chawal Goes to the James Beard Awards: An Indian-American Dietitian's Mission to Feed America Its Humblest Meal
articles.excerpt: Sapna Punjabi's debut cookbook — 85 vegetarian recipes celebrating lentils and rice — has been nominated for a 2026 James Beard Book Award, with a vision that stretches from the kitchen shelf to hospital cafeterias.
articles.image_caption: A traditional plate of dal served over steamed rice, the foundation of Indian home cooking
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Farzi Café Lands in Bellevue: The 'Prince of Indian Cuisine' Launches His Coast-to-Coast American Dream
articles.excerpt: Zorawar Kalra's Michelin Guide-recognised modern Indian bistro opens its first US outpost in Washington state, with plans to blanket the country.
articles.image_caption: Downtown Bellevue, Washington — restaurateur Zorawar Kalra has opened Farzi Café here as part of his coast-to-coast American expansion (Wikimedia Commons)
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Doubles, Bunny Chow, and Nasi Kandar: Inside Drāvida, the East Village Restaurant Tracing South Asia's Diaspora Through Food
articles.excerpt: Chef Aarthi Sampath's new Manhattan restaurant maps the migration of South Asian flavours from Trinidad to Guyana to South Africa — one plate at a time.
articles.image_caption: A rich South Asian curry served in a traditional bowl with aromatic spices
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Chai Spice Is Officially America's Second-Biggest Flavour Trend — And India's Pantry Is Driving the Revolution
articles.excerpt: A major industry report ranks chai spice as the number two flavour trend in North America for 2026, as cardamom, ginger, and clove conquer categories from ice cream to protein bars.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Santiago to Wynwood: How an Indian Restaurant Born in Chile Is Rewriting Miami's Culinary Map
articles.excerpt: Rishtedar, a fine-dining Indian concept launched by an Indian-Chilean entrepreneur, has opened its first US location in Miami's trendiest neighbourhood.
articles.image_caption: An elegant Indian fine-dining spread with aromatic curries and garnishes
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Beyond the Big Metros: Indian Street Food Is Finally Arriving in Raleigh, Worcester, and Peoria
articles.excerpt: From a James Beard-finalist opening Botiwalla in North Carolina to a samosa stall in a Massachusetts public market, Indian cuisine is pushing into cities where dosa and biryani were once exotic novelties.
articles.image_caption: Elegant plating of tandoori chicken over herb rice topped with edible flowers
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Kokum to Curry Leaf Cocktails: How India's Pantry Is Conquering America's Summer Bar Menus
articles.excerpt: Curry leaf bitters in a rum cocktail at Mace, mango-jalapeño tequila at Nova House, and kokum shrubs at craft bars — Indian botanicals are no longer garnish but the main act on American drink lists this summer.
articles.image_caption: An Indian curry dish garnished with fresh herbs, cooked in a traditional wok
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Butter Chicken, Biggie Smalls, and a Venice Beach Opening: Inside the 'Progressive Indian' Movement Rewriting America's Curry Script
articles.excerpt: A new wave of Indian restaurants — from Badmaash in Los Angeles to Indibar in Phoenix — is blowing up the burgundy-carpet stereotype and betting that the diaspora's food deserves the same respect as French and Japanese fine dining.
articles.image_caption: A vibrant selection of Indian starters served with decorative garnish on a wooden platter
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Amritsar to Harvard Yard: Vikas Khanna Named Person of the Year by the University's South Asian Association
articles.excerpt: The Michelin-starred chef, novelist, and filmmaker called the honour 'a promise to continue honouring our culture through every dish, every detail.'
articles.image_caption: Chef Vikas Khanna at an event, one of India's most recognised culinary ambassadors
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indienne Opens in Hudson Yards: Inside America's Most Ambitious Indian Tasting Menu
articles.excerpt: Michelin-starred chef Sujan Sarkar is opening not one but three Indian dining concepts in Manhattan, signalling a new chapter for Indian fine dining in the United States.
articles.image_caption: Exquisite tandoori chicken served with herb rice in a modern fine dining presentation
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dishoom, Gymkhana, and the British Indian Invasion: London's Best Are Finally Coming to America
articles.excerpt: Backed by a $400 million valuation and a sold-out New York pop-up, some of Britain's most celebrated Indian restaurants are crossing the Atlantic — and the diaspora is watching closely.
articles.image_caption: A vibrant spread of tandoori chicken and aromatic curries on a restaurant table
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: The Dosa Missionary: How a College Musician's Classroom Cooking Reel Became a Global Sensation
articles.excerpt: Indian-origin musician Pranva Pannal founded the 'Dosa Student Organisation' and cooked fresh dosas for his classmates during a lecture — and nearly a million people watched.
articles.image_caption: A golden masala dosa served with coconut chutney and sambar on a traditional plate
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Parle-G Ice Cream and Goat Brain Masala: The Restaurants Blowing Up America's Idea of Indian Food
articles.excerpt: From Badmaash's Punjabi steak frites in LA to Dishoom's £400 million arrival in New York, a new generation of Indian restaurants is tearing up the curry-house playbook.
articles.image_caption: Modern Indian fine dining with contemporary plating and vibrant spices
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: From Leicester to Houston: Chaiiwala, Britain's Indian Street Food Giant, Bets Big on America
articles.excerpt: With 115 UK stores, 23 Canadian outlets, and £89 million in annual sales, the karak chai and roti wrap chain is preparing to open its first permanent US location — and sees room for 900 more.
articles.image_caption: A steaming cup of karak chai served alongside Indian street food snacks
